propositions: Direct Anthropic and Bedrock live structured-output cache canaries must be executed with live credentials to attest AC-6 acceptance criterion.
A cache hit is observable only via a two-call sequence: first call writes cache, second call reads cache; both calls must report identical usage counts for cache-eligible prefixes.
Observed cache read/write/input token accounting from live provider calls must match the documented contract in docs/llm-framework.md section on structured retry layers.
The complete-vs-omit branch decision in wire projection must be directly instrumented to record whether failed intermediate responses were omitted.
System prefix must exceed provider's documented minimum cacheable prefix threshold (e.g., 1024 tokens for Anthropic) for cache read/write to be observable.
No credentials or secrets must appear in canary output; only model ids and integer usage counts are recorded.
